# Feature: AI Warm-Up Suggestions

## Summary

During the warm-up phase of a workout session, the app displays 2–5 AI-generated warm-up exercise suggestions tailored to the upcoming exercises and the user's fitness profile. Suggestions are generated by an LLM via an OpenAI-compatible API (default: GitHub Models `gpt-4o-mini`) and cached per workout until the exercise list changes. The user can force a refresh at any time. If the LLM is unavailable, the feature degrades gracefully — the rest of the session is unaffected.

## User Flow

1. User starts a workout session → navigated to `/workout/:id`.
2. **Warmup Phase renders**: below the "Go" button, the "Warm-up ideas" section appears (only when the workout has at least one exercise).
3. A spinner is shown while the first fetch is in progress.
4. Once ready, 2–5 suggestion cards are displayed. Each card shows the exercise name (bold), a short description, and a "▶ How to" link that opens a YouTube search in a new tab.
5. If the LLM call fails, an error message and a "Retry" button are shown instead.
6. The user may click the refresh icon button (top-right of the section) at any time to force a new LLM call and replace the current suggestions.
7. User clicks "Go" when ready — the suggestion section plays no role in advancing the session.

## Data Model

### `WarmupSuggestion` (`api/workout/models.py`)

| Field | Type | Constraints |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `workout` | `OneToOneField(Workout)` | `related_name="warmup_suggestion"`, `CASCADE` |
| `exercises_hash` | `CharField(max_length=64)` | SHA-256 hex digest of ordered exercise names; empty string when workout has no exercises |
| `suggestions` | `JSONField` | List of `{name: str, description: str}` dicts; empty list when workout has no exercises |
| `generated_at` | `DateTimeField` | `auto_now=True` — updated on every write |

One record per workout maximum (OneToOne). Created/updated via `update_or_create`.

## API Endpoints

| Method | URL | Description |
|--------|-----|-------------|
| GET | `/api/workouts/{id}/warmup-suggestions/` | Returns cached suggestions; regenerates automatically if exercise list has changed since last generation. Returns 503 if LLM call fails. |
| POST | `/api/workouts/{id}/warmup-suggestions/` | Forces immediate LLM regeneration regardless of cache state. Returns 503 if LLM call fails. |

Both endpoints require authentication. Ownership is enforced by `WorkoutViewSet.get_queryset()` — requests for another user's workout return 404.

**Response shape (200):**
```json
{
  "suggestions": [
    {"name": "Arm circles", "description": "Rotate arms forward and back to loosen shoulders."}
  ],
  "generated_at": "2026-05-11T14:30:00Z"
}
```

## Frontend

- **Component:** `frontend/src/components/WorkoutSession/WarmupPhase.vue`
  - Calls `wss.reset()` then `wss.fetchSuggestions(workoutId)` in `onMounted`.
  - Conditionally renders the suggestions section only when `ws.workout.exercises?.length` is truthy.
  - Loading state: `ProgressSpinner` (PrimeVue) shown when `wss.loading && wss.suggestions.length === 0` (hides the spinner once suggestions are already present during a refresh).
  - Error state: message + Retry button.
  - Suggestion list: name, description, "▶ How to" anchor to `https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=<name> how to` (`target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`).
  - Refresh button: PrimeVue `Button` with `icon="pi pi-refresh"`, `aria-label="Refresh suggestions"`, `:loading="wss.loading"`.
- **Route:** `/workout/:id` (part of the existing session route; no new route)
- **Store (Pinia):** `useWarmupSuggestionsStore` in `frontend/src/stores/warmupSuggestions.js`
  - **State:** `suggestions` (ref array), `loading` (ref bool), `error` (ref)
  - **Actions:** `reset()`, `fetchSuggestions(workoutId)` (GET), `refreshSuggestions(workoutId)` (POST)
- **Service functions:** `fetchWarmupSuggestions(id)` and `refreshWarmupSuggestions(id)` in `frontend/src/services/workout.js`

## Backend Service Layer

`api/workout/warmup_suggestions_service.py` — isolated module (separately mockable in tests):

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `compute_exercises_hash(workout)` | SHA-256 of `"\|".join(exercise_names ordered by order)` |
| `build_warmup_prompt(exercise_names, profile)` | Builds LLM prompt; includes `fitness_level`, `goals` (human-readable via `_GOAL_LABELS`), `injury_history`; excludes name/email/DOB/weight/height |
| `call_llm(prompt)` | Calls LLM via `openai.OpenAI`; validates response is a JSON array of `{name, description}` dicts; raises `WarmupSuggestionError` on any failure |
| `get_or_generate_warmup_suggestions(*, workout, profile)` | Hash-based cache: returns existing record on hit; calls LLM on miss or stale hash |
| `force_regenerate_warmup_suggestions(*, workout, profile)` | Always calls LLM; bypasses hash check |

`WarmupSuggestionError(Exception)` — raised for all LLM failures (missing config, network error, bad JSON, unexpected shape). The view catches it and returns 503.

## Configuration

Three Django settings (all read from environment):

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `LLM_API_KEY` | `""` | API key / GitHub PAT (`Models:Read` scope for GitHub Models). Empty → LLM disabled; `call_llm` raises immediately. |
| `LLM_API_BASE` | `https://models.inference.ai.azure.com` | OpenAI-compatible base URL. Switch to `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for local Ollama. |
| `LLM_MODEL` | `gpt-4o-mini` | Model name passed to the chat completions API. |

Corresponding `.env.dev` variables: `LLM_API_KEY`, `LLM_API_BASE`, `LLM_MODEL`. `LLM_API_KEY` is intentionally left empty in the committed `.env.dev`; the developer must set their own GitHub PAT.

## Caching Strategy

- Cache key: SHA-256 of `"|".join(exercise_names)` ordered by `exercise.order`.
- Cache hit: `exercises_hash` matches → return the stored record without calling the LLM.
- Cache miss / stale: hash mismatch or no record → call LLM, store result with `update_or_create`.
- Force refresh (POST): always calls LLM regardless of hash.
- Empty workouts: stored as `{exercises_hash: "", suggestions: []}` without calling the LLM.

## PII Policy

The LLM prompt deliberately excludes personal identifiers. It includes only:
- `fitness_level` (categorical)
- `goals` (list of slugs, converted to human-readable labels)
- `injury_history` (free text, user-authored)

Excluded: name, email, date of birth, weight, height, sex.

## Known Limitations / TODOs

- Suggestions are per-workout, not per-session — if two sessions start before the first completes, both get the same cached suggestions.
- No per-set or per-exercise personalisation; the prompt uses the full exercise list.
- YouTube "How to" links are constructed on the frontend using the suggestion name; accuracy depends on LLM naming conventions.
- Rate limit for GitHub Models free tier is ~150 requests/day; the hash-based cache makes this a non-issue under normal single-user usage.
- `LLM_API_KEY` is not set in `.env.prod`; must be added manually before deploying.
